name: Isekai ni Tensei Shitara Densetsu no Yuusha (Uke) Deshita!?
original_name: 異世界に転生したら伝説の勇者（受）でした！？
source:
At the age of seventeen...I died.

However, when I opened my eyes, I was in another world! On top of that, I'm apparently the "legendary hero"?!

Suddenly, a handsome man leaned in to look at my face closely. Hold up, you're too close!

I mean, true, I'm the hero chosen by the dual swords Aloysius, but... There's something wrong with this world!

There isn't a heroine anywhere!

Lacking a heroine isn't a big problem, but why is everyone treating me like the heroine?!

That's right... This is a scary world where the legendary hero is the uke!

Oh, invincible hero, protect yourself and destroy all the BL routes standing in your way!

[Translated from the official website]
